ACTIONS
DRIVE / FERRY
Move to an adjacent city.
COMMERCIAL FLIGHT Reveal an Allied city card in your hand to move to the matching city. Discard a Neutral City card to move to the matching city. You cannot move to a Soviet city using the Commercial Flight action.
UNRECORDED FLIGHT
Discard the City card that matches your city to move to any city.
NEUTRALIZE AGENT
Remove an agent from your city.
SHARE INTEL Either: give a card that matches the city you are in to another player or take that card from another player. The other player must also be in the city with you.
BUILD SAFEHOUSE
Discard the City card that matches your city to build a safehouse there.
IDENTIFY TARGET CITY While at a safehouse, discard 3 City cards matching your region to reveal the target city of your region under an Objective card.
ASSEMBLE TEAM While at a safehouse, discard 5 City cards matching the affiliation of your city to put a team of that affiliation there.
DRIVE / FERRY TEAM
Move a team to an adjacent city.
ACQUIRE TARGETS Select an Acquire Target objective. If you have active teams in the required cities, you complete it. If not, you fail that objective.

SURVEILLANCE
At game end, during the Check Cities step, add a Surveillance sticker to each city containing 1 or more Incident tokens.

LIABILITIES
If you scratch off a circle on your alias and reveal a %, add a Liability sticker to your character.
If necessary, write the name of the region where you received the liability.
FOLLOWED: If you end your turn in a Soviet city, without an agent, add an agent to that city.
AUTHORITIES WATCHING: You may not do the Neutralize Agent action while in a city with an Incident token.
HASSLED: If you end your turn in a Soviet city without a safe house, discard 1 card (after the Draw Cards step).
CIPHER DECODED: You cannot do the Share Intel action when you are in
REGION:
MONITORED: If you draw 2 Soviet City cards at the end of your turn, lose 1 cover.
TRACKED: You cannot do the Drive/Ferry Team action when you are in
REGION:
AIRPORTS ALERTED: You may not do the Unrecorded Flight action from a Soviet city.
RECOGNIZED: If you are in this region, lose a cover whenever an Incident token is added to it.
